column2: Tapes from an older era... some of them game soundtracks. Brings back memories.
One of them is an instrumental I really like.
A song betrayed by the world.

The shell is worn smooth; the label has faded past reading.
There is a melancholy air about the cover.
Off to work. See you down south.
